## Docs audit

> Required for all `feat` and `refactor` PRs. "Not needed" is a valid answer — omission is not.

- [ ] `CONTEXT.md` — domain language table reflects any new types, terms, or UI components. **Not needed** if no new domain concepts introduced.
- [ ] `project-context.md` — routing, layer rules, architectural constraints, or tooling changes recorded. **Not needed** if no architectural changes.
- [ ] `docs/adr/` — ADR created if an architectural decision was introduced or changed. **Not needed** if no hard-to-reverse trade-off made.
- [ ] Space instructions — updated if any agent workflow rule changed. **Not needed** if no workflow change.
